clue.text: Perhaps he's right to gamble and drink

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters of he's could be arranged another way

parts.note: to bet is to gamble

explanation.surface: Someone who may be gambling and drinking at the bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' rearranges HES to SHE. A sherbet is a fizzy powder drink or a sorbet-like iced drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherbet is a sweet fizzy powder once mixed with water as a soft drink.

clue.text: Hire purchase includes a way to get this type of car

indicators.note: includes means the hire purchase letters go around the rest

parts.note: HP is the abbreviation for hire purchase, buying on instalments
RD, road, is a way

explanation.surface: Buying a car on instalments as a means of getting one.
explanation.definitionFit: A hardtop is a car with a rigid, fixed roof.

clue.text: Lover needing capital to acquire ring

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A lover saving up money to buy an engagement ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like money but is a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Romeo, Shakespeare's young lover, stands for any ardent male lover.

clue.text: Signed up in preparation for match

explanation.definitionFit: Engaged means hired, and also promised in marriage ahead of the wedding.

clue.text: Get ready and shave beforehand?

definitions.meaning: to pare, or trim, in advance

explanation.surface: Instructions for a man getting ready to go out, shaving first.
explanation.definitionFit: To prepare is to make ready; split, it reads as paring ahead of time.

clue.text: On Wren moved to find fame

indicators.note: moved means the letters of on wren are shifted about

explanation.surface: Christopher Wren moving on to win fame as an architect.
explanation.definitionFit: Renown is widespread acclaim, the same as fame.

clue.text: Urge boss to obtain security device

parts.note: to press is to urge
a boss is a raised knob or stud

explanation.surface: Pushing the boss to buy a security system.
explanation.definitionFit: A press stud is a snap fastener that keeps clothing securely closed.

clue.text: Check votes again in detail

definitions.meaning: to count ballots a second time

explanation.definitionFit: A recount is a second tally of ballots; to recount is to narrate an account.

clue.text: Coming back into office to stop report

parts.note: to rein in is to stop or check
a statement is a report

explanation.surface: A politician returning to office in order to suppress a damaging report.
explanation.definitionFit: Reinstatement is being restored to a former post.

clue.text: Quiet, on edge and rather demure

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction to play quietly
a rim is an edge

explanation.surface: Describing a quiet, reserved person standing on the edge of things.
explanation.definitionFit: Prim describes someone stiffly proper and modest, a little too demure.

clue.text: Ecological group plant northern vegetable in a Mediterranean country

indicators.note: to plant something is to set it into something else, here into the country
in confirms the planted pieces go inside the country's name

parts.note: Greece borders the Mediterranean
a pea is a vegetable

explanation.surface: Environmental campaigners planting crops in Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: Greenpeace is the international environmental campaigning organisation.

clue.text: High-powered firm

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: powerful in force, and sturdy or resolute in character.

clue.text: Stamps to commemorate Prince George's birth?

definitions.text: Stamps to commemorate Prince George's birth?

parts.words: Stamps to commemorate Prince George's birth?
parts.note: a fresh set of postage stamps is a new release, and a royal baby is also a fresh arrival in the line, or offspring

explanation.surface: Royal Mail marking the birth of Prince George with commemorative stamps.
explanation.walkthrough: Issue means both a print run of stamps and children; Prince George, born 2013, was a new addition to the royal family.
explanation.definitionFit: A freshly released stamp series is so called, and issue also means offspring.

clue.text: Atrophied form of a love goddess

indicators.note: a form of the word atrophied means its letters made into a new shape

explanation.surface: A wasted, shrunken version of a goddess of love.
explanation.definitionFit: Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of love and beauty.

clue.text: Disapprove? Blow it!

parts.note: to show disapproval one may blow a rude noise with the lips

explanation.definitionFit: A raspberry is the rude noise made with tongue and lips to mock.

clue.text: Good man consumed by power

parts.note: ST, saint, is the crossword's good man
ate means consumed

explanation.surface: A saintly man eaten up by the lust for power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' just joins the pieces here, despite looking like a container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A state is a nation as a political power, as in the great powers of Europe.

clue.text: Ends with last of the whisky, somewhat drunk

parts.note: tips are ends, as of fingers

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of the word whisky

explanation.surface: Finishing off the last drop of whisky and feeling merry.
explanation.definitionFit: Tipsy means slightly intoxicated, a little drunk.

clue.text: One mill in ruins is a bad sign

indicators.note: in ruins means the letters of one mill are knocked down and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A ruined mill seen as a bad omen.
explanation.definitionFit: An ill omen is a portent of misfortune.

clue.text: Turn up with a six-footer as escort

parts.note: to attend is to turn up
an ant has six legs, so it is a six-footer

explanation.surface: Arriving at an event with a very tall partner as one's escort.
explanation.definitionFit: An attendant accompanies and serves someone, as an escort does.

clue.text: A hole in ten, unusually high

indicators.note: in means the hole goes inside the rearranged ten
unusually means the letters of ten are put in an odd order

parts.note: a mine is a hole dug in the ground

explanation.surface: A golfer achieving a hole in one, a rare high point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A hole in ten' suggests golf, but the hole is a dug pit; 'unusually' scrambles the number to ENT before the pit goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Eminent means lofty or prominent, high in rank.

clue.text: Vain, yet possibly displaying innocence

indicators.note: possibly hints the letters of vain and yet may be rearranged

explanation.surface: A conceited person who nonetheless shows a childlike innocence.
explanation.definitionFit: Naivety is artless simplicity, lack of worldly experience.

clue.text: An Arab country girl rings the doctor up

indicators.note: rings means the girl's name goes around the doctor

parts.note: Joan is a girl's name

indicators.note: up, in a down clue, means the doctor's letters read upwards

explanation.surface: A girl phoning the doctor from an Arab country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rings' looks like phoning but means encircling.
explanation.definitionFit: Jordan is a kingdom in the Middle East, an Arab state.

clue.text: Where members of society may meet

definitions.text: Where members of society may meet

parts.words: Where members of society may meet
parts.note: a society or club has a room for its members to gather

explanation.definitionFit: A clubroom is the room where a club's members gather.

clue.text: Sarcastic driver on course put in charge

parts.note: on a golf course an iron is a club used to drive the ball

explanation.surface: A motorist on a road course given command, speaking sarcastically.
explanation.walkthrough: 'driver' suggests a motorist, but on a golf course it is a club.
explanation.definitionFit: Ironic speech says the opposite of what is meant, much like sarcasm.

clue.text: Call for peace and quiet

explanation.definitionFit: To order is to demand something, and order also means calm, the state of good discipline.

clue.text: Rashness and cheek? That's about right

indicators.note: about means the word for cheek goes around the letter for right

parts.note: impudence is cheek, insolence

explanation.surface: Someone excusing rash, cheeky behaviour as about right.
explanation.definitionFit: Imprudence is lack of caution, the same as rashness.

clue.text: Conventional fare?

parts.note: a ... is normal daily food, and also a formal assembly or convention, as in the ... of Worms

explanation.definitionFit: A diet is one's usual food, and a diet is a legislative assembly.

clue.text: Never coming to a vital conclusion

definitions.text: Never coming to a vital conclusion

parts.words: Never coming to a vital conclusion
parts.note: a life that never reaches its end is everlasting

explanation.definitionFit: Undying means immortal, never ending in death.

clue.text: Oysters developing at different levels

indicators.note: developing means the letters of oysters grow into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Oysters growing at different depths in the water.
explanation.definitionFit: Storeys are the floors or levels of a building.
